source_question: Thanks so much, amigo! Really appreciate it. 对方说 now you have a lot to read。看下怎么回复，再加一下，等我整理下思路，我可能需要你帮我检查一下。
core: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
meaning_cn: 让我先整理一下思路，之后可能还需要你帮我一起检查一下。
explanation_cn: organize my thoughts 是自然的“整理思路”表达；may need your help to ... 用于礼貌地提前说明后续可能需要对方协助。review everything later 比 check it later 更适合材料、思路或方案尚未完全确定的场景。
source_sentence: 等我整理下思路，我可能需要你帮我检查一下。

examples.en: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
examples.cn: 让我先整理一下思路，之后可能还需要你帮我一起检查一下。

examples.en: Let me organize my thoughts first, then I'll send you a clearer version.
examples.cn: 让我先整理一下思路，然后我会发你一个更清晰的版本。

examples.en: I may need your help to review the deck once I have the structure ready.
examples.cn: 等我把结构整理好后，可能需要你帮我一起检查这份材料。

pronunciation.text: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 organize my thoughts、need your help、review 和 later；Let me 和 I may need 可自然连读，整体语气保持轻松、礼貌。
